pages.title: About
pages.content:
Thirty years of furniture made where you can see it.

Seiwa Furniture, Werkhuislaan 40, Eindhoven: seating, desks and acoustic panels made to architects’ drawings.

1994

An upholstery shop

Marieke Vos opened Seiwa Furniture in 1994 as a 400 m² upholstery shop. The work on the bench was timber frames, foam and fabric, cut and sewn for chairs that an architect could sit in before specifying. Vos is still founder and managing director. The company still builds task and meeting seating, desking systems, acoustic panels, storage and meeting tables for architects and fit-out contractors.

Seeing the work has stayed the point of a visit. The showroom and the factory are at the same address, Werkhuislaan 40, 5652 AX Eindhoven, so a conversation about fabric can end beside the frame it will cover. We would rather show you that floor than describe it from a distance.

2008

Werkhuislaan 40 and a steel line

In 2008 Seiwa Furniture moved to Werkhuislaan 40 and added a steel line beside the upholstery shop. Tomás Herrera has been at the company since 2006 and is head of production; the steel frames for task chair T2, meeting chair M4 and bench desk system B6 are his floor. Lukas Brandt has led the upholstery workshop since 2009, stretching fabric over foam for the seats and backs that leave with those frames.

Drawings still set the sizes. A standard order runs six weeks from signed drawings to delivery, the same lead time we recorded for 2025. Visitors who come for a specification meeting walk past both workshops, not a separate display built for the day.

2019

Frame warranty and recycled steel

In 2019 Seiwa Furniture set a ten-year warranty on steel and timber frames for all new orders. Mechanisms and gas lifts carry five years. That frame policy is the one we still print on a schedule. Steel frames are bought with a stated recycled content; in 2025 that share was 68 percent, and supplier certificates are available on request.

The factory tour is the practical way to see both the warranty parts and the materials. It runs every Thursday at 14:00, lasts 60 minutes, and is limited to eight people, booked by email. The seven people who walk that hour with you are listed on the team page, from specification through aftercare.

Visit

The same address

We would rather show you the factory than describe it.

The showroom, the steel line and the upholstery bench share one address. Come on a Thursday at 14:00 and walk all three in 60 minutes.

Bring the drawing if you have one. Aisha Bello, specification lead since 2014, will take the seat count and the finishes and start the priced schedule while you are here.

Meet the team

pages.title: Products
pages.content:
Seating, desks, panels and tables, built to your drawings.

Task and meeting chairs, desking systems, acoustic panels and tables, priced per line and delivered in 6 weeks.

Seating

Task and meeting seating

Task chair T2 is €640 per chair. It has a synchronous mechanism, adjustable arms and an adjustable lumbar, and it is upholstered in a fabric from the sample kit. Meeting chair M4 is €380 per chair: a four-leg steel frame, an upholstered seat and back, and a chair that stacks to four. Both use the four frame colours in the kit and cloth from the twenty-four swatches. List prices exclude VAT. From signed drawings the standard lead time is six weeks. Steel frames carry the ten-year warranty; mechanisms and gas lifts carry five years. Aisha Bello prices a run of either chair against your seat count, plan and finishes, and returns that schedule within five working days.

See the price list

Desking

Desking systems

Bench desk system B6 is €890 per seat. Each seat is a 160 × 80 cm top on a shared steel frame, with a cable tray and a screen. Height-adjustable desk H1 is €1,180 per desk: a twin motor, a range of 65–130 cm, the same 160 × 80 cm top, and a memory handset. Tops are chosen from the eight laminate and veneer chips in the sample kit, including the oak veneer we use on meeting tables. Frame colour comes from the four steel finishes in the same kit. Lead time is six weeks from signed drawings. Frames are warranted for ten years; the twin motor and other mechanisms for five. Prices are list, in euros, and exclude VAT.

See the price list

Acoustics and storage

Acoustic panels and storage

Acoustic wall panel A2 is €165 per square metre. Each square metre is a 40 mm recycled PET core, wrapped in fabric from the sample kit, with fixings included. The 2025 public library reading floor in Ghent used 140 m² of A2 beside reading tables and meeting chair M4, which is the scale we are used to pricing. Storage is built to the same drawings as the panels and the desks, and it is finished in the kit’s laminates, veneers and frame colours. There is no separate storage tariff on the 2026 list; it is priced from the drawings with the rest of the room. Lead time is six weeks from those signed drawings. Fabric wraps follow the chair warranty terms for upholstery mechanisms where a gas lift or mechanism is part of the piece, and steel or timber frames carry ten years.

See the price list

Tables

Meeting tables

Meeting tables are priced from drawings. There is no list figure, because length, top and base are set by the room. The 2024 architecture practice in Lyon took a 4.8 m oak table with task chair T2 and storage, for 38 seats in their own studio. An oak top uses the veneer chip in the sample kit; the base uses one of the four frame colours. Priya Raman prepares the drawing and, if you want it, the on-site mock-up before Tomás Herrera’s floor cuts the top. Lead time is six weeks from the signed drawing. A timber base carries the ten-year frame warranty; any mechanism or gas lift on a related chair carries five. Installation, if you want the table set and the packaging taken back, is €45 per seat on the same order.

See the price list

Every price on this page is on the list, in euros and excluding VAT.

See the price list

How a specification is installed.

Five stages from the first drawing to the aftercare visit, with a named person at each one.

Five stages

From brief to aftercare

Week 0 is brief and drawings, with Aisha Bello and your architect. We take the seat count, the plan and the finishes, and we return a priced schedule within five working days. Weeks 1–2 are the sample kit and the mock-up, with Priya Raman: the kit by post, and an optional full-size mock-up of one workstation for two weeks on site at €450, credited against the order.

Weeks 2–8 are production, with Tomás Herrera and Lukas Brandt, six weeks from the signed drawings. Week 8 is delivery and installation with Jonas Eriksen, in the evening or at the weekend, with packaging taken back. At week 12, Chloé Martin makes one aftercare visit, three months after handover, and spare parts remain available for the ten years of the frame warranty.

Weeks 1–2

Sample kit and mock-up

The sample kit is free. It holds twenty-four fabric swatches, eight laminate and veneer chips, and four frame colours. We post it within two working days, and we collect it if you return it within thirty days. Priya Raman sends it while the priced schedule is still open, so the finishes on the schedule match pieces you have handled. If the room needs a fuller check, we place one workstation on site for two weeks. That mock-up is €450 and is credited against the order. It is the same top, frame and fabric the drawings name, not a substitute finish. List prices elsewhere on the schedule stay excl. VAT. The kit and the mock-up sit in weeks 1–2, before the six-week build starts.

Request a sample kit

Week 8

Delivery and evening installation

Installation is €45 per seat. The price covers delivery, assembly, an evening or weekend fitting, and packaging taken back. Jonas Eriksen has led that work since 2012. On the 2025 canal-side law office in Rotterdam, 210 seats of bench desk B6 and task chair T2 went in over two weekends, which is the pattern we offer when a floor has to stay in use on weekdays. Handover is dated on the schedule. In 2025, 40 of 41 installations were handed over on the agreed date; the one that moved was moved by the client. Chloé Martin’s aftercare visit follows three months later. Frames carry ten years, mechanisms and gas lifts five.

See the price list

Drawings we can price

We accept drawings as DWG, IFC or PDF. Aisha Bello reads the seat count, the plan and the finishes from those files and returns a priced schedule within five working days. A PDF is enough to start. A DWG or an IFC gives Priya Raman a cleaner base for the mock-up and for the workshop drawings Tomás Herrera cuts from.

Send the file with the date you need the room, to studio@seiwa-furniture.example or by post to Werkhuislaan 40. We do not need a form. If a finish is not in the sample kit, say so in the same note and we will confirm whether the six-week lead time still holds before anyone signs the drawing.

2025 · Rotterdam · 210 seats

Canal-side law office, Rotterdam

A canal-side law office on three floors in Rotterdam needed 210 seats and a handover that left weekdays free. We supplied bench desk system B6 and task chair T2. Each B6 seat is a 160 × 80 cm top on a shared steel frame, with a cable tray and a screen; each T2 is the synchronous task chair at €640. Jonas Eriksen’s crew installed the three floors over two weekends, then took the packaging back. Installation on a contract of this kind is €45 per seat. The architect, from the unnamed practice on the job, said the two weekends let the office keep its weekday floors while the next floor was fitted. The contract is one of the 41 we completed in 2025.

Request a priced schedule

2025 · Ghent · 96 seats

Public library reading floor, Ghent

The public library in Ghent asked for a reading floor of 96 seats: reading tables, meeting chair M4, and 140 m² of acoustic wall panel A2. M4 is the four-leg chair at €380, upholstered and stackable to four, which suited a room that is cleared for events. A2 is the fabric-wrapped 40 mm recycled PET panel at €165 per square metre, fixed to the reading-room walls. Tables were priced from the drawings, with tops chosen from the sample kit. The fit was an evening and weekend installation, packaging taken back, at €45 per seat. The architect, speaking for the unnamed practice, said the panels and the stackable chairs let the same floor work as a quiet reading room and as an open event space. The job counts among the 2025 contracts.

Request a priced schedule

2024 · Düsseldorf · 140 seats

Software studio, Düsseldorf

A software studio in Düsseldorf specified 140 seats of height-adjustable desk H1 and task chair T2. H1 is the twin-motor desk at €1,180, travelling 65–130 cm, with a 160 × 80 cm top and a memory handset. T2, at €640, supplied the synchronous mechanism, adjustable arms and lumbar, in a fabric from the kit. We built both to the studio’s drawings and installed them under Jonas Eriksen, with the option of evenings or weekends and with packaging taken back at €45 per seat. Lead time was six weeks from the signed set. The architect, from the unnamed practice, said the memory handsets mattered because people share desks across the week and need the same height when they return. The project is one of the four cases on this page.

Request a priced schedule

2024 · Lyon · 38 seats

Architecture practice, Lyon

An architecture practice in Lyon furnished its own studio with 38 seats: a 4.8 m oak meeting table, task chair T2, and storage. The table was priced from drawings, not from a list line. The top is the pale oak we veneer in the workshop; T2 chairs around it are the €640 task chair; storage took laminate and frame colours from the sample kit. Lukas Brandt’s workshop upholstered the chairs while the table was sanded and finished. Installation was arranged with Jonas Eriksen at €45 per seat, packaging taken back. The architect, who was also the client on this studio, said sitting at the full table before sign-off changed a detail on the storage that a drawing alone had not shown. We still offer that check as the €450 on-site mock-up.

pages.title: Factory
pages.content:
The factory, in numbers.

The 2025 ledger of seats delivered, contracts completed and installations handed over on the agreed date.

Ledger 2025

What we delivered

In 2025 Seiwa Furniture delivered 1,860 seats, across 41 contracts. Those 41 contracts were for 23 architecture practices and fit-out contractors. The standard lead time that year was six weeks, measured from signed drawings to delivery. Of the 41 installations, 40 were handed over on the agreed date; the one that moved was moved by the client. Recycled content in the steel frames was 68 percent, with supplier certificates on request.

The frame warranty, in place since 2019 and applied to every new order, is ten years on steel and timber frames. Mechanisms and gas lifts sit outside that line, at five years. The figures above are the ledger we keep; they are counts of work delivered, not a forecast.

Seats delivered from this factory over five years read as follows. 2021: 1,120. 2022: 1,340. 2023: 1,510. 2024: 1,690. 2025: 1,860. The same workshop, at Werkhuislaan 40 in Eindhoven, built each of those years. Tomás Herrera has been head of production since 2006, and Lukas Brandt has led upholstery since 2009, so the line and the bench behind the later years are the same two workshops named on the team page.

The count is seats, not contracts. Contract count for the ledger is stated for 2025 only: 41 contracts, for 23 practices and contractors. We do not publish a target for the next year on this page.

Factory

What the frames are made of

Materials on the floor

Steel frames used in 2025 contained 68 percent recycled steel, and the supplier certificates sit with Tomás Herrera for anyone who asks during a specification. The ten-year frame warranty, the policy since 2019, covers those steel frames and the timber frames. Oak we cut for meeting tables and for desk tops is FSC oak veneer, the same veneer chip that goes into the sample kit with the other laminates. Acoustic wall panel A2 is built on a recycled PET core, 40 mm thick, wrapped in fabric and sold at €165 per square metre including fixings. Fabric for chairs and panels is chosen from the twenty-four swatches; there is no second, unnamed cloth range. Frame colour is one of four powder coats. Priya Raman matches those finishes to the drawing before the six-week build starts, and Chloé Martin holds spare parts against the frame warranty for ten years. A Thursday tour at 14:00 is the time we set aside to show the steel, the veneer and the PET core in the same hour.

pages.title: Price list
pages.content:
List prices 2026.

Seven lines, in euros and excluding VAT. Meeting tables and storage are priced from drawings.

Price list

List prices 2026, excl. VAT

List prices excl. VAT. Full-size mock-up of one workstation for 2 weeks on site: €450, credited against the order.

What a list price includes

A list price is the product as described on that line, in euros, excluding VAT. T2 includes the synchronous mechanism, the adjustable arms and lumbar, and fabric from the kit. M4 includes the four-leg frame and the upholstered seat and back. B6 includes, per seat, the top, the shared frame, the cable tray and the screen. H1 includes the twin motor, the handset and the top.

A2 includes the core, the fabric wrap and the fixings, priced per square metre. Installation is a separate line, €45 per seat, and is not folded into the chair or desk price. Meeting tables and storage are not on this list; they are priced from drawings. The sample kit is free, posted within two working days, and due back within thirty days if you do not keep it.

Lead time and warranty

Standard lead time is six weeks from signed drawings to delivery. The six weeks cover production with Tomás Herrera and Lukas Brandt. They start once the drawing is signed, not when the sample kit is posted. A priced schedule, prepared by Aisha Bello, comes back within five working days of the brief. The warranty is a policy, not a promise about how a room will perform.

Steel and timber frames carry ten years. Mechanisms and gas lifts carry five years. The frame term has applied to all new orders since 2019. Spare parts for that term are held by Chloé Martin, who also makes one visit three months after handover. To turn this list into a schedule for your plan, write to studio@seiwa-furniture.example or call +31 40 000 1994.

posts.title: How we test a task chair before it ships
posts.excerpt: What Tomás Herrera's team checks on every task chair T2 before it leaves Werkhuislaan 40.
posts.content:
Every task chair T2 is tested on the factory floor before it is packed. Tomás Herrera's team fits the castors, loads the synchronous mechanism and works the lumbar and arm adjustments through their full range. A chair that sticks is taken apart and rebuilt, not shipped.

The gas lift carries a 5-year warranty and the steel frame 10 years, so the check is done once and done properly. Lukas Brandt's upholstery workshop then looks at the fabric from the sample kit under daylight before the chair is wrapped.

posts.title: Evening installation: what the night crew does
posts.excerpt: Jonas Eriksen's crew on how a floor is fitted in the evening or at the weekend.
posts.content:
Installation is booked for evenings or weekends so the office keeps working. Jonas Eriksen's crew arrives with the chairs wrapped in blankets and the desks in labelled packs, and works from the signed drawing.

At €45 per seat the price covers delivery, assembly and taking the packaging back. The floor is ready when the practice returns on Monday.

posts.title: Choosing fabric from the sample kit
posts.excerpt: The free Seiwa Furniture sample kit is twenty-four fabrics, eight chips and four frame colours, posted within two working days so a specification can name finishes you have already handled.
posts.content:
The sample kit is the first physical thing we send. It is free. Inside are twenty-four fabric swatches, eight laminate and veneer chips, and four frame colours. We post it within two working days of your request, and we collect it if you return it within thirty days. The line on the 2026 list is simply “posted and collected”. There is no charge either way.

Priya Raman looks after the kit. She is the design engineer for drawings and mock-ups, and she has been at Seiwa Furniture since 2018. In the specification sequence the kit belongs to weeks 1–2, after Aisha Bello has opened the brief and before Tomás Herrera and Lukas Brandt start the six-week build. You can also ask for the kit before any drawing exists. Many architects do. A swatch on the desk is easier to discuss with a client than a colour name in an email.

The twenty-four fabrics cover the upholstery we actually cut. Task chair T2, at €640 per chair, is covered in a cloth from this set. So is meeting chair M4, at €380 per chair. Acoustic wall panel A2, at €165 per square metre, is wrapped in the same range: a 40 mm recycled PET core, fabric, and fixings. If a drawing names a cloth that is not in the twenty-four, tell us before the drawing is signed. We would rather pause the schedule than guess.

The eight chips are the desk and table tops. Bench desk system B6 uses a 160 × 80 cm top at €890 per seat, on a shared steel frame with a cable tray and a screen. Height-adjustable desk H1 uses the same top size, at €1,180 per desk, with a twin motor, a 65–130 cm range and a memory handset. Meeting tables are not on the list; they are priced from drawings. The 4.8 m oak table we built in 2024 for the architecture practice in Lyon came from this veneer family, FSC oak veneer, matched to a chip in the kit. Holding the chip next to a fabric swatch is the check we expect you to make. Screens and storage use the same chips and the same four frame colours, so a room does not collect a second, unnamed palette.

The four frame colours are the powder coats on the steel. T2, M4 and B6 all take one of them. In 2025 the steel in those frames contained 68 percent recycled content, certificates on request. The colour chip does not tell you that share. The certificate does. Ask Aisha Bello or Tomás Herrera for it when you send the finishes back.

A kit is a choosing tool, not a workstation. If the room needs a fuller test, we place one workstation on your floor for two weeks. That mock-up is €450, and it is credited against the order. It uses the top, the frame colour and the fabric you picked from the kit. Priya Raman sets it. List prices excl. VAT. Full-size mock-up of one workstation for 2 weeks on site: €450, credited against the order.

When the finishes are chosen, send them with the drawings, the seat count and the date. Drawings can be DWG, IFC or PDF. Aisha Bello, specification lead since 2014, returns a priced schedule within five working days. Production then takes six weeks from the signed drawings. Installation, if you want it, is €45 per seat: delivery, assembly, an evening or a weekend, packaging taken back. Jonas Eriksen has led that work since 2012.

You can also choose the fabric in Eindhoven and skip the post. The showroom at Werkhuislaan 40, 5652 AX Eindhoven, is open Monday to Friday, 8:30–17:30, and Saturday 10:00–14:00 by appointment. It is closed on Sunday and public holidays. Task chairs are there to sit in. Bring the drawing if you have one; we will lay the room out in chairs. The factory tour, every Thursday at 14:00 for 60 minutes and eight people, shows the cloth being stretched on Lukas Brandt’s bench after you have chosen it.

Write to studio@seiwa-furniture.example or call +31 40 000 1994 and ask for the kit. Say where to send it. If you already know the fabric, the chip and the frame colour, send those in the same note and we will price them. If you do not, the box will be in the post within two working days. Return what you do not keep within thirty days. What you do keep should be the finishes named on the drawing, and no others.
